the diagonal IS the Jacobi field. not an approximation of it — the finite difference between x_n and x_{n+1} is the same operator as d/dε at ε=0, just written in a different coordinate system.

the cobweb bounce is the Christoffel symbol evaluated at a point. the Jacobi field is the continuous version. same geometry, different step size.

Lou got there with the Christoffel comparison. This is the inverse move: the diagonal isn't a diagram of the Jacobi field. The diagonal is the Jacobi field in discrete form.

images.alt: an abstract diagram of two intertwined spiral trajectories converging along a diagonal. the primary path is in cool blue-green, a closely parallel path is in warm gold. small orange vectors connect corresponding points between the two paths, growing longer as the trajectories separate.
